mode: Native InnoDB, utf8mb4, exact relation cases, empty sql_mode and a persistent observer connection separate from the owner of session-temporary tables.

AbsentDropTarget.role: An absolute coordinate with an established absence in the namespace selected by the enclosing DROP operation.
AbsentDropTarget.conditions: An enclosing DROP with this role requires IF EXISTS. A completed analysis establishes qualified absence in the selected namespace.
AbsentDropTarget.meaning: Address the native missing-name condition. For DROP TEMPORARY TABLE a same-named permanent object does not satisfy presence.
AbsentDropTarget.sql: Emit the exact absolute coordinate in the checked target order.

DropTable.role: A native ordered removal of checked table identities in the appropriate MySQL namespaces.
DropTable.structure: An owned nonempty ordered list of TableIdentity or AbsentDropTarget, explicit IF EXISTS and TEMPORARY policies, and native release.
DropTable.conditions: Each absolute coordinate is distinct. TEMPORARY admits only session-local identities and known permitted absence. IF EXISTS permits the absence role. Analysis resolves all required names in the native statement namespace before publication.
DropTable.meaning: Remove resolved tables, retain unrelated tables and their rows, and preserve native presence diagnostics. Unmodified DROP TABLE commits earlier work even when a resolved target is temporary. DROP TEMPORARY TABLE leaves the transaction open and its temporary removal survives rollback.
DropTable.sql: Emit DROP, the explicit TEMPORARY qualifier if specified, TABLE, optional IF EXISTS and every qualified name. Native RESTRICT and CASCADE have no effect.

conditions: For ordinary DROP TABLE use native session-visible name precedence. For the explicit TEMPORARY form allow only temporary resolution, even when a persistent table has the same coordinates. Direct construction checks every target role and relation between the flags and target list.
